text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen delivered a splendid run in 
the Kikuka-sho.

Though unable to hide her frustration, 
Mejiro Ryan offered words of 
congratulations to Mejiro McQueen—

The two promised to have another serious 
showdown in their next race.

And... her next target was the Tenno Sho 
(Spring). Mejiro McQueen was eager to show 
the culmination of her efforts.
